rule: One row per business order
business_reason: Every KPI denominator counts orders; a repeated order would count twice.
detection: order_id duplicated after cleaning (raw duplicates reported by the cleaning stage)
detail: raw duplicate rows removed by cleaning: 1 (corrected; conflicting copies kept in quarantine)

rule: order_id present and well-formed
business_reason: An order without an identifier cannot be joined to any other system.
detection: null order_id (quarantined) or layout not matching the O##### pattern
detail: 0 rows quarantined for null order_id; 0 ids with a different layout (kept)

rule: orders.customer_id maps to a known customer
business_reason: Customer-level metrics and app-interaction joins need a real customer.
detection: customer_id not in customers
detail: null=0, unknown=0

rule: orders.restaurant_id maps to a known restaurant
business_reason: Restaurant attribution of delay is impossible for an unknown restaurant.
detection: restaurant_id null or not in restaurants
detail: null=1, unknown=0

rule: orders.driver_id maps to a known driver
business_reason: Driver attribution and telemetry joins need a real driver.
detection: driver_id null or not in drivers
detail: null=0, unknown=0

rule: tickets.order_id maps to an order
business_reason: A complaint that cannot be tied to an order cannot be reconciled with the operational story.
detection: order_id null or not in orders
detail: null=3, unknown=0

rule: restaurant_status rows map to an order and agree on the restaurant
business_reason: Status events for a foreign order (another platform?) would corrupt restaurant metrics.
detection: order_id not in orders OR restaurant_id differs from the order's restaurant
detail: unknown order=0, restaurant mismatch=0

rule: app actions map to an order and its customer
business_reason: Customer interaction counts must belong to the right order.
detection: order_id not in orders OR customer_id differs from the order's customer
detail: unknown order=0, customer mismatch=0

rule: interventions map to an order
business_reason: An intervention without an order cannot be linked to an outcome.
detection: order_id not in orders

rule: orders and Dispatch cover each other
business_reason: Assignment/reassignment context comes only from Dispatch; missing coverage hides reassignments.
detection: order missing in dispatch, or dispatch record whose order is unknown
detail: orders without dispatch record=0; dispatch records for unknown orders=0

rule: driver events map to an order
business_reason: Telemetry for unknown orders cannot be used for pickup/delivery inference.
detection: order_id not in orders

rule: final_status uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: The KPI counts 'delivered' orders only; a new status ('suspended', 'Delivered') would silently leave the population.
detection: value not in {delivered, cancelled} after representation normalisation
detail: representation fixes=2; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={}

rule: traffic_bucket uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: Traffic breakdowns need consistent buckets.
detection: value not in {low, medium, high, severe}
detail: representation fixes=2; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={}

rule: weather_bucket uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: Weather breakdowns need consistent buckets.
detection: value not in {clear, rain, heavy_rain}
detail: representation fixes=0; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={}

rule: restaurant status uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: 'handoff' vs 'handed_off' may be two systems or two meanings.
detection: value not in {preparing, ready, handed_off, unknown}
detail: representation fixes=2; unexpected values={'handoff': 1}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={'handoff': 'handed_off'}

rule: ticket category uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: Complaint mix by category drives the customer-view comparison.
detection: value not in the six support categories
detail: representation fixes=2; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={'eta_issue': 'eta_changed'}

rule: app action_type uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: support_opened / cancel_attempted flags depend on it.
detection: value not in {ETA_VIEWED, SUPPORT_OPENED, CANCEL_ATTEMPTED}
detail: representation fixes=0; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={}

rule: intervention_type uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: Intervention metrics are grouped by type.
detection: value not in the four intervention types
detail: representation fixes=0; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={}

rule: dispatch_status uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: Cross-check of order status against Dispatch.
detection: value not in {completed, cancelled}
detail: representation fixes=0; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={}

rule: driver event type uses an agreed vocabulary
business_reason: Lifecycle reconstruction relies on assigned/picked_up/delivered.
detection: value not in {assigned, gps_ping, picked_up, delivered}
detail: representation fixes=0; unexpected values={}; semantic candidates (owner decision)={}

rule: KPI timestamps are parseable
business_reason: Unparseable promised_eta / actual_delivery_at silently shrink the KPI population.
detection: value present but not parseable as a datetime
detail: orders.created_at: unparseable=0, tz-aware=0; orders.promised_eta: unparseable=0, tz-aware=0; orders.pickup_at: unparseable=0, tz-aware=0; orders.actual_delivery_at: unparseable=0, tz-aware=0

rule: Promised ETA is after order creation
business_reason: A promise made before the order exists is not a promise; lateness against it is meaningless.
detection: promised_eta < created_at
detail: minutes early: [10.0]

rule: Delivery happens after pickup
business_reason: A delivery timestamp earlier than pickup means one of the two clocks is wrong.
detection: actual_delivery_at < pickup_at
detail: minutes before pickup: [5.0]

rule: Pickup happens after order creation
business_reason: Stage durations would be negative.
detection: pickup_at < created_at

rule: Delivered orders carry an actual delivery time
business_reason: Without actual_delivery_at the order's lateness is unknown; excluding it biases the rate if the missing ones are not random.
detection: final_status == delivered and actual_delivery_at is null
detail: 14 delivered orders lack actual_delivery_at; 14 of them have a driver 'delivered' event that could back-fill it (owner decision)

rule: Cancelled orders carry no delivery time
business_reason: A cancelled order with a delivery time is a status bug.
detection: final_status == cancelled and actual_delivery_at not null

rule: Dispatch chronology (created <= assigned <= reassigned)
business_reason: Assignment timing feeds the dispatch-wait stage.
detection: assigned_at < created_at OR reassigned_at < assigned_at

rule: Driver-event chronology (assigned <= picked_up <= delivered)
business_reason: Telemetry used to recover missing delivery times must be internally consistent.
detection: picked_up < assigned OR delivered < picked_up per order
detail: picked_up<assigned=4, delivered<picked_up=0

rule: Delivery distance is plausible
business_reason: A 999 km 'estimate' would distort any distance analysis.
detection: distance <= 0 or > max_plausible_distance_km or null

rule: Restaurant coordinates are inside the service area
business_reason: Geo-based prep/travel inference is impossible with lat=95.
detection: lat/lon outside the Bengaluru bounding box

rule: GPS pings are inside the service area
business_reason: Outlier pings would corrupt any route/arrival inference.
detection: lat/lon outside the Bengaluru bounding box

rule: Driver attributes in range
business_reason: Sanity of the driver dimension.
detection: rating outside 0-5 or experience_months < 0

rule: orders.driver_id agrees with Dispatch's final driver
business_reason: If the orders table keeps the ORIGINAL driver after a reassignment, driver-level metrics blame the wrong person.
detection: orders.driver_id != dispatch.driver_id
detail: orders.driver_id equals dispatch ORIGINAL driver for 407 orders -> the orders table is not updated after reassignment; Dispatch is authoritative for the final driver

rule: orders.pickup_at agrees with the driver picked_up event
business_reason: Two systems, one fact - they should agree.
detection: abs difference > 60 s
detail: compared 393 orders

rule: Intervention log agrees with Dispatch reassignments
business_reason: If DRIVER_REASSIGNMENT interventions do not appear in Dispatch (or vice versa), one log is incomplete.
detection: orders with a DRIVER_REASSIGNMENT intervention vs orders with dispatch.reassigned_at
detail: dispatch reassigned=18, intervention DRIVER_REASSIGNMENT=43, in both=0, only in interventions=43, only in dispatch=18

rule: Restaurant status updates are fresh enough for the intended use
business_reason: 'ready' recorded after the driver already picked up is useless for live ETA and unfair for restaurant accountability.
detection: status in {ready, handed_off} with last_updated_at later than the order's pickup_at (+ SLA)
detail: status rows joined=127 covering 127 of 407 orders (31.2%); ready/handed_off written >15 min after pickup=3; updated before order creation=0; median lag vs pickup=-4.9 min; timestamps have minute precision only

rule: Order weather label agrees with independently observed rainfall
business_reason: Operations attributes lateness to weather using weather_bucket; if the label does not match what actually fell from the sky, weather-based explanations and any model trained on the label are built on sand.
detection: join each order's creation hour to Open-Meteo hourly precipitation for Bengaluru; compare labelled rain (rain/heavy_rain) with observed rain (> threshold mm); Cohen's kappa < 0.2 = no better than chance
detail: hours covered=100.0%; agreement=54.1%; Cohen's kappa=-0.004; mean observed mm by label={'clear': 0.45, 'heavy_rain': 0.34, 'rain': 0.55}

rule: 'Late' has one agreed definition and owner
business_reason: Four stakeholders define late differently; publishing one number without an owner invites disputes.
detection: client_metric_definitions.json lists conflicting definitions and no canonical owner
detail: no canonical KPI owner documented; 4 stakeholder definitions found: VP Operations: Any delivered order after the promised ETA is late.; Support Lead: Only more than 10 minutes beyond ETA should count as meaningfully late.; Finance: Cancelled/refunded orders should not count in operational performance.; Data Team: Historical dashboard uses delivered orders with non-null actual delivery time.
